overall_reason: A share-document panel where every element is set in one pale grey on a grey ground, so the squint shows an even grey block with no order between title, settings and action.

score.reason: T-SQUINT fails: the title, the access row and the 'Copy link' button blur into one grey field, although T-LEFT-EDGES finds a single clean left edge.

findings.evidence: In dom-1440.json the title 'Share document', the access row and 'Can view' are rgb(164,173,179) and 'Launch brief' rgb(174,183,189), on a grey panel over a grey ground; the button is a pale fill with rgb(238,241,243) text. 03-lenses/squint/1440-00.png shows one even grey rectangle with no element heavier than another.
findings.before: One grey value for title, body, controls and action.
findings.after: Set the order by value: dark title, mid-grey secondary text, and a filled dark 'Copy link' as the heaviest block.
findings.why: With no step in weight or value, the reader must read every line to find the action, and the panel reads as disabled.

strengths: Title, subtitle, access row and button share one left edge at x=420, and the button spans the inner width.
not_investigated: 00-contract.md is absent from the run, so the visitor mode was inferred from the artifact: a single product composition (card, window or scene), judged as a component in Operate terms
T-FIVE-SECOND, T-SCREEN-BY-SCREEN, T-HEADINGS-READ, T-STOCK-ORDER, T-COMPOSITION-RUN and T-ANATOMY: the artifact is one composition on one tile, with no page, fold or section sequence
flat_hierarchy: the sweep skipped it where only one type role exists; the squint render stands in only as a viewing aid
Text contrast against WCAG is lens-a11y's and the sweep's call, not this lens's.
